text:
olivia: Quick thread to lock down redirects + schema + internal-link plan for next week's launch + webinar. Need final decisions by 18:00 PT.

matt: TL;DR: canonical targets, 301 patterns for old campaign slugs, Event + FAQ for webinar, Dataset for benchmark tables, and a simple internal-link priority list.

jenna: uploading a tiny CSV sample to seed redirects.csv: 

old_url,new_target,redirect_type,notes
/campaigns/q3-bench,/blog/2026-inference-launch,301,global campaign pages -> canonical blog
/blog/bench-short,/blog/2026-inference-launch,302,staging alias -> final 301 at deploy
/webinar/signup-old,/webinar/register,301,legacy form -> new register flow
/docs/bench-methods,/blog/bench-methods,301,methods moved to blog appendix

seo_bot: Reminder: preserve UTM/query params on redirects and avoid redirect chains. Pattern rule suggestion: ^/campaigns/(.*)$ -> /blog/2026-inference-launch 301, but add exclusions for /campaigns/partners.

matt: Schema notes: webinar register page = Event schema + FAQ (top 5 Qs). If we embed recording later, add VideoObject on the recording page. Benchmark article = Article + Dataset for CSV/HTML tables, add HowTo for methodology steps. Add OG and twitter meta for socials.

jenna: internal linking priorities: 1) blog hero CTA -> /webinar/register, 2) blog -> methodology appendix, 3) docs -> blog for conceptual context. Use descriptive anchors (avoid "click here").

olivia: content rules: if a docs page is <300 words and substantially duplicates blog, merge content or add rel=canonical to blog. Only use canonical for true duplicates.

infra_ops: Note: edge deploy blackout 23:00-02:00 PT. Schedule redirect application after 02:30. Staging previews: https://preview.redwood.ai/<pr-id>.

matt: crawl check: i'll run a quick crawl and flag pages with >30 internal links — those must keep original anchor text in redirect mapping.

jenna: checklist for PRs (to add to template): meta title, meta desc, canonical present/removed, schema snippet (if required), OG/twitter, hero CTA to register (if applicable), redirect row in redirects.csv.

olivia: action owners: jenna -> redirects.csv + PR template update; matt -> crawl + link-count report; olivia -> submit meta/canonical PR by 17:30. I'll sign off at 18:00. :rocket:

seo_bot: Automated reminder scheduled: verify schema on staging via view-source and JSON-LD validator once PR preview is available.

infra_ops: acknowledged. schedule set for post-maintenance redirect rollout.

matt: thanks — will post crawl report by 16:45.
